elevate.move: Make the photographs specimens of the cylinder system: mask the photos inside tall graduated cylinder outlines with the yellow level line drawn across the image and a ledger caption, so the downspout band and the hero photo frame read as measured samples on the same lab bench instead of a generic full-bleed slab.

Recompose the hero around one large cylinder beside a ≤8-word h1 that names Seattle gutters: the cylinder fills to 623 gal as the proof, the ledger rows hang off its ticks, ZIP folds into the ledger as a row, one ask (Call); on 390 one cylinder sits above the fold.
